source.title: Analysis of Donations Received by National Political Parties — FY 2024–25
source.locator: Printed page 18, Annexure 1: top ten BJP donations; printed page 15, CPI(M) donor table; printed page 24, Annexure 4.

retrieval: Original publisher PDF HTTP 200, 1474308 bytes, 33 pages; independently reviewed by oversight agent.
finding: The retained ₹15 crore Waaree-to-BJP claim has no substantiating payment source. Its cited ADR report lists selected top donors, not an exhaustive BJP contribution return. Absence from those tables cannot disprove the claimed donation. The unsupported arrow is withdrawn and preserved here as correction history; no replacement payment or definitive negative claim is inferred.
limitations: No exact alleged payment date or transaction amount is admitted into the graph.
Withdrawal concerns this unsupported retained assertion, not a judicial acquittal or a finding that every possible affiliated contribution was absent.
